text.formatted: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, you can replace that property with the Push, Sap, or Slow property for that attack.
text.plain: When you attack with a weapon whose mastery property you can use, you can replace that property with the Push, Sap, or Slow property for that attack.

gaps.name: Using Push, Sap, or Slow in place of the weapon's own mastery property for one attack: nothing yet says a rider is used instead of another, so the weapon's own would still run.
